statements.text: The double cover is already in the role: every linear lift of the role grid's SL(2,3) sends the 2 pi turn to -P, -1 on a parity-even doublet, with the Legendre law (-1/p) P confirmed at five primes; the 2 pi turn about each grid point is minus the model's phase-point operator, so every signed weight is W(x) = -<R_x>/3; the husk's tetrahedral turns lift to it through the depth-fixing conjugations; and no knot can carry it, because the 2 pi turn lies in the commutator subgroup.
